original.statement: Argo CD now delivers on-deployed notifications when a sync operation completes without changing the application's health status.

decision.reason: [ev-86b636e38d6e] is a bug fix saying on-deployed notifications are now delivered when a sync did not change the app's health status. With the same configuration, delivery now behaves differently at runtime, so behavior-changed is the right change type. The name on-deployed-notification-delivery is short kebab-case built from the evidence's own words. No more specific subject family fits.
